# Amazon Bedrock doc history — captured 2026-08-26
# Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/doc-history.html  (renders fine)

## NEWEST ENTRY ADVANCED TO **August 24, 2026** — BUT IT IS A CORRECTION, NOT AN ADDITION. HELD.
"Corrected Claude Sonnet 5 thinking guidance: adaptive thinking is on by default and can be disabled."
The Claude Sonnet 5 model card had wrongly said adaptive thinking is ALWAYS ON and CANNOT be disabled.
Corrected: on by default (including when the `thinking` field is omitted), turned off only by
`"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}`; `budget_tokens` NOT supported on this model; thinking tokens billed
as output tokens; revisit `max_tokens` when migrating from Claude Sonnet 4.6. Sonnet 5 added to the
Adaptive thinking supported-models table.
=> A documentation accuracy fix. No new API, service or entity. BELOW THE BAR.

## Entries below it — all previously reported, unchanged
Aug 19 — Anthropic Messages API samples repointed to the `bedrock-runtime` **/anthropic** route
         (base_url="https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/anthropic", short-term bearer token
         from aws-bedrock-token-generator provide_token()). 49 non-Anthropic model cards had
         OPENAI_BASE_URL repointed from the bedrock-mantle /v1 route to bedrock-runtime **/openai/v1**.
         Messages API tabs reordered to lead with bedrock-runtime; the bedrock-mantle curl tab moved
         to the end. Reported 2026-08-21/08-23.
Aug 15 — endpoint guidance now RECOMMENDS `bedrock-runtime` for new applications incl. OpenAI- and
         Anthropic-compatible workloads. Reported 08-21.
Aug 15 — follow-up bedrock-runtime positioning; Quickstart samples use Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol;
         **Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber** and **Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol** added to the Models at a
         glance table. Reported 08-14/08-21.
Aug 14 — AgentCore Memory integration for Bedrock agentic retrieval via `memoryConfiguration` on
         **AgenticRetrieveStream**. Reported 2026-08-21 (MED/AIDR).
Aug 11 — IAM principal cost allocation now supported on the bedrock-mantle endpoint.
Jul 31 — Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic no longer open to new customers (deprecation; out of scope).

## STANDING RULE — mantle vs runtime (unchanged, still correct)
BOTH endpoints serve the OpenAI AND Anthropic API shapes. AWS reversed its recommendation toward
`bedrock-runtime` on 2026-08-15/19, but `bedrock-mantle` "continues to be fully supported" and the
mantle-only pages remain: Web Search, **Projects**, **Workspaces**, Chat Completions on mantle, the
mantle Responses API page.
=> **SELECT PARSERS BY ROUTE PATH (/anthropic, /openai/v1, /v1), NOT BY HOSTNAME.**
Projects/Workspaces remain the mantle control-plane entities.

## API Reference — re-verified 2026-08-26, UNCHANGED
docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/welcome.html lists six surfaces:
Amazon Bedrock | Agents for Amazon Bedrock | Agents for Amazon Bedrock Runtime | Data Automation for
Amazon Bedrock | Runtime for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation | Amazon Bedrock Runtime.
Both Agents sections now carry the Agents-Classic closed-to-new-customers note. No new API surface.

Updated: 2026-08-26 — newest entry is Aug 24 but it is a doc correction; no reportable addition.
